description: AGSC-03-19 and AGSC-03-20 with AGSC-01-22: foreign link names are mapped on import and never added to the vocabulary - refines becomes narrower, conflicts-with becomes excludes, blockedBy becomes blocked-by and tests becomes verifies - and from 1.1 the record arrives as a draft. This case replaces imp-0004. Derivation over one OKF document with those four keys and an established licence (CC0-1.0): the mapped frontmatter carries the four Link keys with the same targets and none of the four foreign spellings, each mapping is reported once as the AGSC-E506 warning of AGSC-01-22, so four warnings, and the record is written with status draft and one further AGSC-E506 for that, five in all and no error. The licence is established, which before 1.1 left the record published; the case isolates the mapping and the draft by its input alone.
